prompt.description: The user's onboarding request in natural language.

model.description: Optional hint: target model specification (HF hub ID or local path).

local_path.description: Local checkpoint path if onboarding private weights.

task.description: Target pipeline tag or model architecture task.

mode.description: Optional. Omit only when tpu-agent could not resolve the user's intent; tpu-model-onboarding cannot ask, so an unset mode is a question its caller still owes.

compute_target.description: Optional compute runtime target (local, tpu-vm, gke-xpk).

servers.description: Optional: servers an earlier onboarding in this session left serving, each copied verbatim from that onboarding's result. A sweep of several shapes may measure on one whose deployments_json and launch_recipe files have the same contents as this deployment's, beside its own servers; it never cancels one.

profile.description: compute_profile from that result: the compute profile the server runs under.

deployments_json.description: output_files.deployments_json from the result that launched it.

launch_recipe.description: output_files.launch_recipe from the result that launched it.

checkpoint_bucket.description: Optional gs:// bucket for shared checkpoints: onboarding stages a Hugging Face model there once (stage_checkpoint.py) and every job reads it from GCS instead of the Hub. On gke_job the pods must be able to read it (a pod_service_account, or the profile's own staging_bucket); otherwise, and by default, onboarding stages into the profile's staging_bucket.

onboarding_path.description: Optional onboarding path resolved during query intake: dynamo_unwiring (unwiring NVIDIA Dynamo manifests or GPU deployments to llm-d on TPU) or existing_deployment.

dynamo_manifests.description: Optional local path (or list of paths) to exported NVIDIA Dynamo (DynamoGraphDeployment / DynamoComponentDeployment) or GPU Kubernetes manifests to unwire into llm-d TPU manifests (dynamo_unwiring).

source_namespace.description: Optional live source Kubernetes namespace hosting Dynamo on GPUs (dynamo_unwiring).

source_context.description: Optional kubectl context for the source GPU cluster.

target_namespace.description: Optional target Kubernetes namespace for llm-d distributed serving on TPU (e.g. 'vllm-serving').

target_context.description: Optional kubectl context for the target TPU cluster.

deployments_json.description: Optional path to single-VM deployments.json to carry over tuned vllm serve flags and environment variables into distributed serving.

vllm_patch.description: Optional path to a single-VM vllm_torchtpu runtime patch (.patch or .py) to carry over into distributed serving.

standalone_epp.description: Optional flag to deploy a standalone EPP + Envoy router Deployment (omitting Gateway and InferencePool CRDs when not installed on the target cluster).

epp_service_account.description: Optional ServiceAccount name for the EPP router when explicitly specified by the user.

hardware_budget.description: Optional TPU slice budget captured during query intake.

traffic_profile.description: Optional traffic shape (ISL/OSL, prefix cache ratio, concurrency sweep) captured during query intake.

sla_constraints.description: Optional tail-latency and interactivity SLA constraints captured during query intake.

examples.prompt: Benchmark meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on TPU against CPU.
Unwire our NVIDIA Dynamo deployment for Qwen 3.5 to llm-d on GKE TPU v7x and optimize throughput for AgentX
